structured.answer: Harel has a bunch of products, but the page only showed me the קופת גמל להשקעה tracks (16). Fees are all about 0.55%, so I'd go with the "מניות" track at 24.04% a year, or the S&P 500 one at 13.7%.

Most rows show 'פחות מ־3 שנים' instead of a number, so I couldn't compare them
Didn't know what yellow vs teal meant or what מט"ח is
